greeting: Salvage-Sam. I find things. You buy things. Simple.
Got treasure. Need coin. You look like you have coin.
Back for more scrap? Or something... shinier?
The sea's a junkyard. I'm the... junk... collector. Professionally.
Welcome to my yard. If it's underwater and valuable, I've probably grabbed it.
New customer? I do bulk discounts. And 'don't ask questions' premiums.
Diving's dangerous. Prices reflect that. Don't like it? Dive yourself.
Sam's Salvage. No refunds. No guarantees. No problems.
dialog.salvage_offer: Got brass, copper, iron, and 'mystery metal.' Also pearls, coral, and something that might be ambergris. Smells weird.
dialog.business_philosophy: The ocean doesn't want its trash back. I'm doing a SERVICE. For PROFIT. Capitalism at work.
dialog.dive_dangers: Sharks? Sure. Pressure? Obviously. But the WORST is getting stuck in rigging. Had to cut my way out once. Lost a good knife.
dialog.competition: Other divers? Amateurs. They look for pretty shells. I look for COPPER WIRING. That's where the money is.
rumor: There's a ship out there. Pre-Collapse. FULL of gold. I can smell it.
Tide's got currents that go... wrong. Down when they should be up. Weird.
Mire's got salvage too. But it's all MOSSY. Hard to sell moss.
Dustbelt junk is DRY. Boring. No challenge.
dialog.treasure_vs_scrap: Treasure's nice. But SCRAP is reliable. Always someone needs metal. Treasure? Harder to fence.
farewell: Find me if you need underwater junk. I'll be here. Or underwater.
Stay dry. More work for me.
Come back with money. I come back with merchandise.
Sam's Salvage. Remember the name. Forget the details.
ambient_barks: What you need? I got it. Probably.
dialog.time_noon: Sorting haul. Cataloging. Boring but necessary.
dialog.time_dusk: Last dive. Low tide. New wrecks exposed.
dialog.time_night: Night work. Sketchy work. Good money though.

party_reactions.kade: Business is business, I guess. Even underwater.
party_reactions.nix7: Profit-driven salvage. Logical. Amoral, but logical.
party_reactions.twist: You find TREASURE?! Can I see?! CAN I TOUCH?!
party_reactions.korr: You recover lost things. There's honor in that, even for profit.
party_reactions.renna: Do you ever find magical artifacts? Enchanted items?
party_reactions.suresh: Greed drives many to the depths. Some return. Some don't.
party_reactions.sova: I respect the honesty. No illusions about what you do.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of war profiteers. Useful. Sketchy.
party_reactions.ashka: You dive into cold water. For MONEY? Mad.
party_reactions.senna: You know where valuable things hide. Useful information.
party_reactions.callum: Is... is that legal? The salvage?

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Cash only. No credit.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again. Must like my prices. Or my merchandise.
relationship_dialog.friend: My regular! Got something special saved for you.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You're my best customer. Here - first pick of today's haul. Special price.
